summary: Iteration 3 frontend testing — institutional fonts, OAB logo, and mobile responsiveness. 33/40 assertions passed. The OAB logo, mobile hamburger/drawer, mobile responsiveness, no-horizontal-overflow across viewports (360/390/768/1024/1440), and /proposta mobile layout are all working. CRITICAL FINDING: Newsreader font is NOT being applied to <h1>/<h2> elements at runtime — Tailwind's `font-serif` utility class is overriding the `@layer base` font-family rule. Newsreader is loaded by the browser but never used; headings render in the system ui-serif (Times-like) fallback instead.

ui_bugs.issue: <h1>/<h2> computed font-family = 'ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif' — Newsreader is loaded (document.fonts shows Newsreader 200-800 'loaded') but NOT used. Root cause: Hero.jsx (and other components) apply Tailwind utility class `font-serif`, which lives in `@layer utilities` and overrides the `@layer base h1,h2,h3,.font-serif { font-family: "Newsreader"... }` rule in /app/frontend/src/index.css (Tailwind layer order: base < components < utilities). Canvas measureText confirms Newsreader vs ui-serif render at different widths (119px vs 105.7px @ 64px size), so Newsreader IS available — just not applied. Visual result: headings look like generic Times/Georgia instead of Newsreader Publico-Banner-style.

issues: Because Newsreader is not actually applied, the institutional typography goal of iteration 3 is visually NOT achieved on headings (body Hanken Grotesk is correctly applied, but serif headings fall back to system Times/Georgia).

action_items: FIX TYPOGRAPHY OVERRIDE (CRITICAL): The Newsreader font is loaded but not applied to <h1>/<h2> because Tailwind's `font-serif` utility class (theme.fontFamily.serif default = ['ui-serif','Georgia',...]) wins over the `@layer base` override in /app/frontend/src/index.css. Recommended fix: extend Tailwind theme in /app/frontend/tailwind.config.js with `theme.extend.fontFamily.serif = ['Newsreader','Publico Banner','ui-serif','Georgia','serif']` so the `font-serif` utility itself maps to Newsreader. (Alternative: move the override into `@layer utilities` or add `!important` — but theme override is cleanest.) Same applies to `font-mono` if needed.

(Optional) Note that the only 'Manrope' string in the bundle comes from the platform-controlled 'Made with Emergent' badge in public/index.html — not a real failure of the spec but worth being aware of when grepping.

(Optional) Main agent should self-verify credit-card preview OAB logo visually by clicking through the stepper to step 2 (Pagamento) and selecting Cartão de crédito, or by switching to Single-page flow at desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: Tailwind utility vs @layer base ordering trap: redefining `.font-serif` inside `@layer base` does NOT work — utilities always win. Either override `theme.fontFamily.serif` in tailwind.config.js, or scope the new font-family rules to `@layer utilities`. Same trap applies to any future attempt to redefine `.font-mono`.

Hero.jsx and several other components apply both an `<h1>` tag AND the `font-serif` Tailwind class. With the recommended theme.extend fix this becomes a no-op (both resolve to Newsreader), so no component changes are needed.

OABLogo 'chip' variant adds a -0.5 absolute accent bar at the bottom. This looks intentional but on very small chip sizes (size<24) the -bottom-0.5 underline can clip outside the parent's overflow:hidden containers — confirmed not an issue at size=40 used in header.
PageActionsHeader mobile drawer uses framer-motion height:auto animation which can briefly cause vertical layout shift on slower devices. Acceptable for a prototype.

success_rate.frontend: 82.5% (33/40 assertions); core OAB-logo & mobile-responsive features 100%, typography goal not achieved on headings.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 testing focused on (1) Hanken Grotesk + Newsreader fonts, (2) /brand/oab-logo.png logo placement, (3) mobile-first responsive layout. Mobile responsiveness (390x844), hamburger menu, drawer, no-horizontal-overflow across 360/390/768/1024/1440, OAB logo image (/brand/oab-logo.png, HTTP 200, in header+hero+footer), and /proposta page mobile layout — ALL PASS. Body uses Hanken Grotesk correctly. CRITICAL: Newsreader font is downloaded by the browser but NOT applied to headings because Tailwind's `font-serif` utility class overrides the `@layer base` override. Fix is a one-liner in tailwind.config.js (theme.extend.fontFamily.serif). Credit-card preview logo (PaymentStep) was not directly verified because payment-method-* testids only mount after the user advances to step 2 of the stepper; code-review confirms <OABLogo variant='mark'> was wired in correctly per spec. After the font fix, recommend re-running just the typography section (h1/h2 computed style assertion) plus a quick spot-check of credit-card preview logo via Single-page flow.
rca of the issue: Root cause for typography failure: In Tailwind v3, layer specificity is base < components < utilities. The custom CSS in /app/frontend/src/index.css redefines `h1, h2, h3, .font-serif { font-family: "Newsreader"... }` inside `@layer base`. The Hero.jsx <h1> uses Tailwind utility class `font-serif`, which Tailwind generates inside `@layer utilities` mapping to `theme.fontFamily.serif` default = ['ui-serif','Georgia','Cambria','"Times New Roman"','Times','serif']. Utility wins. Verification: window.getComputedStyle(h1).fontFamily === 'ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif'; document.fonts has Newsreader entries with status='loaded'; canvas.measureText('Test') @64px = 119px in Newsreader vs 105.7px in ui-serif (proves Newsreader IS available but unused). Mitigation: Add `theme.extend.fontFamily.serif = ['Newsreader','Publico Banner','ui-serif','Georgia','"Times New Roman"','serif']` in /app/frontend/tailwind.config.js. After restart of frontend (yarn / hot reload), the `font-serif` utility itself will map to Newsreader and all <h1>/<h2>.font-serif elements will render correctly.
